def candidate_transform(g):
    out=[r[:] for r in g]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); bg=max(set(x for r in g for x in r),key=lambda c:sum(r.count(c) for r in g)); fg=next(x for r in g for x in r if x!=bg)
    active=[any(x==fg for x in r) for r in g]
    i=0
    while i<h:
        if not active[i]: i+=1; continue
        j=i
        while j<h and active[j]: j+=1
        band=g[i:j]
        far=max((c for r in band for c,x in enumerate(r) if x==fg),default=-1)
        for rr in range(i,j):
            last=max((c for c,x in enumerate(g[rr]) if x==fg),default=-1)
            if last==far and last+1<w and all(x==bg for x in g[rr][last+1:]):
                for c in range(last+1,w): out[rr][c]=1
        i=j
    return out
cand=candidate_transform(grid)
